questions.question_text: I am an Argentine forward who spent 17 seasons at Barcelona, later played for Paris Saint-Germain and Inter Miami, and captained my country to the 2022 World Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: His senior club career includes Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and Inter Miami, and he led Argentina to the 2022 FIFA World Cup title.

questions.question_text: I am a Portuguese forward whose major European clubs include Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus. I also hold the record for most UEFA Champions League appearances. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA lists Ronaldo with 183 Champions League appearances and records his spells at Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus.

questions.question_text: I am a French attacker who rose to prominence at Monaco, became a star at Paris Saint-Germain and later joined Real Madrid. I won the 2018 World Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: FIFA's profile traces his club career through Monaco, Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid and records his 2018 World Cup win with France.

questions.question_text: I am a Croatian midfielder, won the 2018 Ballon d'Or and helped my country reach that year's World Cup final. I won six Champions League titles with Real Madrid. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA identifies Modrić as Croatia's 2018 Ballon d'Or winner and records his six Champions League titles with Real Madrid.

questions.question_text: I am an Egyptian forward who played for Chelsea before spells at Fiorentina and Roma led to my Liverpool breakthrough. I have won the Premier League Golden Boot four times. Who am I?
questions.explanation: The Premier League records Salah's Chelsea, Fiorentina, Roma and Liverpool career and four Golden Boot awards.

questions.question_text: I am a French striker who became Arsenal's record Premier League scorer, won four Premier League Golden Boots and also played for Barcelona. Who am I?
questions.explanation: The Premier League lists Henry as Arsenal's record Premier League scorer and a four-time Golden Boot winner.

questions.question_text: I am an Ivorian striker who played for Marseille, Chelsea and Galatasaray. I am among Africa's highest scorers in UEFA club competitions and won the Champions League with Chelsea in 2012. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's African-player record lists Drogba at Marseille, Chelsea and Galatasaray and among the leading African scorers in UEFA club competition.

questions.question_text: I am the Brazilian legend who won three FIFA World Cups, starred for Santos and later played for the New York Cosmos. Who am I?
questions.explanation: FIFA identifies Pelé as the only player to win the World Cup three times and documents his Santos and New York Cosmos legacy.

questions.question_text: I am a Brazilian playmaker, won the 2002 World Cup and was twice named FIFA World Player of the Year. I became famous for my dazzling skill at Barcelona. Who am I?
questions.explanation: FIFA confirms Ronaldinho's 2002 World Cup title and two FIFA World Player of the Year awards.

questions.question_text: I am a Spanish midfielder who spent most of my career at Barcelona, won the 2010 World Cup and made 130 Champions League appearances. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's all-time Champions League appearances list records Iniesta with 130 appearances for Barcelona.

questions.question_text: I am a Ukrainian forward who won the Ballon d'Or in 2004. My Champions League career included Dynamo Kyiv, AC Milan and Chelsea, and I scored 48 goals in the competition. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's historical Champions League scoring table records Shevchenko's goals and clubs; he won the 2004 Ballon d'Or.

questions.question_text: I am a Swedish striker whose European career included Ajax, Juventus, Inter, Barcelona, AC Milan and Paris Saint-Germain. I scored 42 Champions League goals. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's Champions League scoring list records Ibrahimović's clubs and 42 goals.

questions.question_text: I am an Italian forward best known for Juventus, where I became a club icon. UEFA records 42 Champions League goals for me. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's historical Champions League scoring list credits Del Piero with 42 goals, all associated with Juventus.

questions.question_text: I am an Italian striker who scored 46 Champions League goals and won the competition with AC Milan in 2007. I previously played for Juventus. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's scoring list records Inzaghi with 46 Champions League goals and lists Juventus and AC Milan among his clubs.

questions.question_text: I am a Brazilian attacking midfielder who won the Champions League with AC Milan in 2007 and later joined Real Madrid. I scored 30 goals in the competition. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's Champions League scoring table records Kaká with 30 goals and lists AC Milan and Real Madrid.

questions.question_text: I am a Spanish striker who won the Champions League with Real Madrid, later reached a final with Monaco and also played for Liverpool. UEFA credits me with 33 Champions League goals. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's scoring table lists Morientes with 33 goals and clubs including Real Madrid, Monaco and Liverpool.

questions.question_text: I am a Dutch midfielder who won the Champions League with Ajax, Real Madrid and AC Milan. UEFA records 125 appearances in the competition. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's all-time appearances list records Seedorf with 125 Champions League appearances across Ajax, Real Madrid and Milan.

questions.question_text: I am a Dutch striker whose Champions League career included PSV, Manchester United and Real Madrid. UEFA records 56 goals for me in the competition. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's historical scoring list records van Nistelrooy with 56 Champions League goals and names PSV, Manchester United and Real Madrid.

questions.question_text: I am a Portuguese-born forward known as the Black Panther. I became a Benfica legend and scored 47 goals in the European Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's historical European Cup scoring table credits Eusébio with 47 goals; he became synonymous with Benfica.

questions.question_text: I am a Liberian forward who won the 1995 Ballon d'Or and played for Monaco, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan. UEFA records 35 goals in UEFA club competitions. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's African-player statistics list Weah with Monaco, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan and 35 UEFA club-competition goals.

questions.question_text: I am a Cameroon-born striker whose European career included Real Madrid, Mallorca, Barcelona, Inter and Chelsea. I scored 48 times in UEFA club competitions. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's African-player record lists Eto'o's clubs and 48 goals in UEFA club competitions.

questions.question_text: I am a German goalkeeper who played for Schalke before becoming a long-serving Bayern Munich number one. I have 164 Champions League appearances. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's all-time appearances list records Neuer's Schalke and Bayern appearances and his 164-match total.

questions.question_text: I am an Italian goalkeeper whose Champions League career included Parma, Juventus and Paris Saint-Germain. I also lifted the 2006 World Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's appearance table lists Buffon's Champions League clubs as Parma, Juventus and Paris Saint-Germain.

questions.question_text: I am a Spanish centre-back whose Champions League appearances came mainly with Real Madrid, with later spells at Paris Saint-Germain and Sevilla. I won the 2010 World Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA records Ramos with Real Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain and Sevilla in the Champions League appearances table.

questions.question_text: I am a Spanish goalkeeper who made 150 Champions League appearances for Real Madrid and another 27 for Porto. I captained Spain to the 2010 World Cup. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA records Casillas with 150 Champions League appearances for Real Madrid and 27 for Porto.

questions.question_text: I am a French striker whose Champions League record includes 19 appearances for Lyon and 133 for Real Madrid. I won the 2022 Ballon d'Or. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's all-time table lists Benzema's Lyon and Real Madrid appearances; he won the 2022 Ballon d'Or.

questions.question_text: I am a Polish striker whose Champions League career includes Borussia Dortmund, Bayern Munich and Barcelona. UEFA records 144 appearances in the competition. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA lists Lewandowski's Champions League appearances across Dortmund, Bayern and Barcelona.

questions.question_text: I am a German midfielder who won the 2014 World Cup and played Champions League football for Bayern Munich and Real Madrid. UEFA records 151 appearances. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA's all-time appearances table records Kroos with Bayern and Real Madrid and 151 Champions League appearances.

questions.question_text: I am a Welsh winger who spent my entire senior club career at Manchester United and won 13 Premier League titles. I made 141 Champions League appearances. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA records Giggs with 141 Champions League appearances for Manchester United; the Premier League records his 13 winners' medals.

questions.question_text: I am a Spanish forward who played 130 Champions League matches for Real Madrid and 12 for Schalke. I captained Madrid before later playing in Germany. Who am I?
questions.explanation: UEFA lists Raúl with 130 Champions League appearances for Real Madrid and 12 for Schalke.
